acceptance: t1-pm-7 real Android app recording and polished portrait and landscape renders

recording.app: design.takeone.tidewater, offline Tidewater test fixture; no accounts, network access, or personal apps
recording.capture_source: scripts/e2e/android/record.ts and src/android/*; unchanged between capture_commit and render_commit
recording.render_worktree_change: wide-phone cues keep the title lane at top and place priority cues below the modal

source_video.original: screen.webm from the real take directory

render_from_same_take: node bin/takeone.mjs make <absolute-take-path> --no-jev --set idle_speed=1 --set out_w=1920 --set out_h=1080
derivatives: ffmpeg -y -v error -i recording-raw.mp4 -i portrait.mp4 -filter_complex '[0:v]trim=start=2.1:duration=10,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,scale=540:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=540:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2[raw];[1:v]trim=duration=10,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,scale=540:960,pad=540:1080:0:60[render];[raw][render]hstack=inputs=2,fps=30,format=yuv420p[v]' -map '[v]' -t 10 -an -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -preset veryfast raw-vs-render-first-10s.mp4
